title: Checkout Reliability Review
utterances: Priya Example
Let's start with the retry storm from last Tuesday.
Marco Example
Payments retried every failed charge immediately, which hammered the gateway.
Priya Example
Proposal: move payment retries onto a Kafka topic called retry-events with exponential backoff.
Jonas Example
Agreed. Let's do that, retry-events it is.
Marco Example
Second item, idempotency keys. We lose them when the order service re-publishes.
Priya Example
We should preserve idempotency keys end-to-end, from checkout through settlement.
Jonas Example
Yes, decided. Keys travel with the message headers everywhere.
Marco Example
What about the dead-letter queue retention?
Priya Example
Seven days of dead-letter retention, and alert when it passes a thousand messages.
Jonas Example
Approved, go ahead with seven days.
Marco Example
Okay. That's the three things for today.
